(323)ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rgyun khyer bzhugs so/skyabs sems sngon 'gro bas/oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/oṃ mi gnas mi da

tei:div.tei:p: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rgyun khyer bzhugs so/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro bas/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ mi gnas mi dmigs de bzhin nyid/ āḥ rtsal snang 'gags med snying rje gdangs/ nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu gsal/ hūm̐/ zung 'jug rig stong rjen pa 'dir/ rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥdamar shar/ rtsal dang rtsal las 'od 'phros pas/ snang srid dag pa bde chen zhing*/ gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus/ zla gam dmar po chos 'byung steng*/ pad+ma nyi ma ro gdan dbus/ rang rig hrīḥdamar yongs gyur las/ don dam 'bras bu'i mkha' 'gro ma/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo dmar/ dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba ltar/ gzi brjid 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrig zhal gcig phyag gnyis dor stabs can/ spyan gsum dmar zlum mche ba gcigs/ dbu skra khams nag thur la 'phyang*/ (324)spyi gtsug phag zhal nag mo ngur/ phyag g.yas gri khug nam mkhar 'phyar/ g.yon pas thod khrag zhal du gsol/ thabs mchog yab dang gnyis med phyir/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ g.yon du bskal/ dar dang me tog rus pas brgyan/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil sgrogs/ snang stong chu zla bzhin du gsal/ rang nyid phag mor gsal ba yi/ spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus/ 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dkar gsal steng*/ me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang : gtso 'khor sum brgya drug cu gsal/ mgrin pa ro 'dus 'khor lo'i dbus/ 'dab bzhi chos 'byung ser gsal steng*/ mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum dang*/ gtso 'khor brgyad gnyis bcu drug gsal/ dharmā tsakra'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ 'dab bzhi chos 'byung mthing gsal (325)steng*/ chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum dang*/ gtso 'khor sum brgya rtsa gnyis gsal/ lte ba skyed byed 'khor lo'i dbus/ 'dab bzhi chos 'byung dmar nag dbus/

pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dang*/ gtso 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi gsal/ gsang gnas myong byed 'khor lo'i dbus/ 'dab bzhi chos 'byung ljang gsal dbus/ las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum dang*/ gtso 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad gsal/ sku yi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyi/ rigs lnga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gros kyang*/ til gyi gang bu gtam pa bzhin/ them 'gags nem 'gags nyid dang ni/ gsal la ma 'dres lhun gyis grub/ hūm̐/ don dam dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro rnams/ gshegs byon bzhugs par ma dmigs kyang*/ (326)sgrub mchog bdag la byin rlob phyir/ ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad byung gis/ rang bzhin dbyings nas gshegs su gsaul/ dam ye gnyis med ngo bor bzhugs/ 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang la 'dud/ gzung 'jin dbyings su grol ba'i rtsal/ ye shes rol pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho/ rang snang ye shes lha la 'bul/ 'dod yon ma spang rgyan du che/ ma hā pū ja hoḥhrīḥ don dam thig le nyag gcig zlum/ dbyings las longs sku mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal ba kun gyi yum phag mor/ stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos/ chos sku'i yon tan rdzogs la bstod/ nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing*/ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje mor snang*/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ longs sku'i yon tan rdzogs la bstod/ ma nges gnas gsum sprul pa'i zhing*/ rigs (327)dang rigs kyi bdag mor bzhengs/ gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ngom/ mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ mchog thun dngos grub stsol la bstod/ āḥ rang gi snying gi dkyil sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gsal ba'i thugs kar g.yung dung dga' ba 'khyil ba'i dbus su hrīḥyan lag bzhi la ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya brgyad gnyis/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ri/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ni/

las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar sa bsam la/ de dag gi mthar yi ge 'bru brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam la/ sngags bzlas pa'i sgra dang 'od kyis snang srid thams cad mer mer khyom khyom 'ur 'ur shig shig tu dag par bsam la/ hrī ma hā ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsirta hriṃ hriṃ jaḥjaḥ zhes pa 'di ni rig 'jin (328) bla ma'i sku'i sras skal bzang bstan 'jin gyi dgongs bzhed bzhin/ sa sprel zla 2 ches 25 la rten 'brel phun tshogs pa du ma'i rkyen gyis sngags btsun las 'brel rtsal gyis blo mtsho las byung ba shar mar spel ba dge'o/// /
